### From Jacob to Israel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jacob-israel
Passage: Genesis 32:27-28
Points:
- Jacob must surrender his name and confess his past deceit before receiving God's blessing.
- Admitting the name "Jacob" signals yielding his self-will and acknowledging his guilt.
- God graciously forgives Jacob and gives him the name Israel, refusing to let past sin define him.
- Prevailing with God does not mean overpowering Him, but clinging to Him in utter dependence.
- Believers can hold fast during painful trials knowing that God sovereignly uses them for their good.

### The God of Peniel
Author: Warren Gage
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-of-peniel
Passage: Genesis 32:24-32
Points:
- God wrestled with Jacob and touched his hip socket to break his physical self-sufficiency.
- Through this wounding, Jacob became weak in the flesh but made strong in the spirit.
- Jacob clung to the Lord and refused to let go until he was blessed and renamed Israel.
- Naming the site Peniel commemorated God's mercy in sparing Jacob after a face-to-face encounter.
- Jacob's nocturnal wrestling anticipates Christ wrestling with God in Gethsemane for our ultimate salvation.
